rationale: Sharon's work on production-ready AI agent infrastructure at TheAgentic.Ai touches on domains like robotics and hardware systems where accuracy is critical, while Parth brings hands-on expertise in mechanical and hardware testing for humanoid robotics at Tesla. Their complementary skills—Sharon's infrastructure and tooling background paired with Parth's robotics hardware validation experience—could yield interesting conversations around how AI agents interface with physical systems, especially given the hackathon context.
intro_message: Sharon, meet Parth Behani — he's a robotics hardware test engineer at Tesla working on humanoid robots, and your work on AI agent infrastructure for accuracy-critical domains could spark some useful ideas around agent-hardware integration.
